import unittest

from solution import ChainNode, merge_sorted_chains


def chain(values):
    nodes = [ChainNode(value) for value in values]
    for left, right in zip(nodes, nodes[1:]):
        left.next = right
    return (nodes[0] if nodes else None), nodes


def collect(head, limit=100):
    values = []
    nodes = []
    while head is not None:
        if len(nodes) >= limit:
            raise AssertionError("unexpected cycle")
        nodes.append(head)
        values.append(head.value)
        head = head.next
    return values, nodes


class MergeSortedChainsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_only_none(self):
        self.assertIsNone(merge_sorted_chains([]))
        self.assertIsNone(merge_sorted_chains([None, None]))

    def test_pairwise_merge_reuses_nodes_and_is_stable(self):
        h0, n0 = chain([1, 2, 2, 7])
        h1, n1 = chain([1, 2, 5])
        h2, n2 = chain([2, 2, 6])
        merged = merge_sorted_chains([h0, h1, h2])
        values, nodes = collect(merged)
        self.assertEqual(values, [1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 5, 6, 7])
        self.assertEqual(nodes, [n0[0], n1[0], n0[1], n0[2], n1[1], n2[0], n2[1], n1[2], n2[2], n0[3]])
        self.assertEqual({id(node) for node in nodes}, {id(node) for node in n0 + n1 + n2})

    def test_none_entries_do_not_affect_order(self):
        first, first_nodes = chain([1, 3])
        second, second_nodes = chain([1, 2])
        merged = merge_sorted_chains([None, first, None, second])
        values, nodes = collect(merged)
        self.assertEqual(values, [1, 1, 2, 3])
        self.assertEqual(nodes, [first_nodes[0], second_nodes[0], second_nodes[1], first_nodes[1]])

    def test_single_chain_is_returned_unchanged(self):
        head, nodes = chain([-2, 0, 4])
        result = merge_sorted_chains([head])
        self.assertIs(result, head)
        self.assertEqual(collect(result)[1], nodes)

    def test_rejects_bad_heads_and_node_values(self):
        for bad in (None, (), {}, "x"):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    merge_sorted_chains(bad)
        for value in (True, False, 1.5, "1", None):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    merge_sorted_chains([ChainNode(value)])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            merge_sorted_chains([object()])

    def test_rejects_unsorted_chain(self):
        head, _ = chain([1, 4, 3])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            merge_sorted_chains([head])

    def test_rejects_cycle(self):
        a = ChainNode(1)
        b = ChainNode(2)
        a.next = b
        b.next = a
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            merge_sorted_chains([a])

    def test_rejects_shared_nodes_between_chains(self):
        shared = ChainNode(3)
        first = ChainNode(1, shared)
        second = ChainNode(2, shared)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            merge_sorted_chains([first, second])

    def test_rejects_non_node_next_reference(self):
        head = ChainNode(1)
        head.next = "not a node"
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            merge_sorted_chains([head])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
